what_happened: Both consumer-repository tasks the user named (sf1-engine task 33, sapience-app task 50) independently confirm this record's claims without needing to clone or probe either repo's source beyond reading their own specs/TODO.md: sf1-engine's task 33 is a near-verbatim mirror of deliverables 1-2 scoped to its own 3-root shell-suite tree (same owed-not-paid language, same classification (a)/(b)/(c)/(d) shape), and sapience-app's task 50 is the measured non-shell (pytest) evidence deliverable 6 cites, and its own text states the resolver output shape it will adopt only if 650 has not landed first -- confirming the sequencing is real, not asserted.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier-Justification honesty scan flags all six suite-naming justifications as fabricated because one not-yet-existing path per phase escalates suite_selection_select's union to __FULL_SWEEP__, while the named suites are the true per-path output for the existing files in the same lists. The validator inherits the exact union-escalation collapse deliverable 2 replaces, giving this record authoring-time self-demonstrating evidence and a second acceptance signal for the per-path resolver.

test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh's external-source-store fixture case checks the REAL repo's own manifest.json/git-tracked files, not a synthetic fixture, so a newly Write-created file must be git-add-staged before re-running the suite or it reports the new manifest row as absent. Restaging before re-verifying resolved it cleanly.

Phase 8's complete-gate-set run (tests/run-all.sh, full 204-suite corpus) surfaced test-gate-out-repair-reporting.sh as a reproducible FAIL in isolation (Cases 3/4/6/6b: validate-artifact.sh's SKILL_VALIDATE_FIXES/SKILL_VALIDATE_FIXED_FILES globals report 0 fixes where the suite expects nonzero). Confirmed unrelated to task 650: neither the suite nor its subjects (validate-artifact.sh, command-gate-out.sh) were ever touched by this task's commits; last touched by tasks 418/328/381/597/459. Not fixed here (out of this task's file_scope); recorded for separate attention.

Phase 8's complete-gate-set run surfaced test-mcp-merge-target.sh as a reproducible FAIL in isolation (Assertions C and E: a hand-written .mcp.json entry does not survive a force-reload/regenerate cycle). Confirmed unrelated to task 650: neither the suite nor .mcp.json merge-target handling were ever touched by this task's commits; the suite was last touched by task 29. Not fixed here (out of this task's file_scope); recorded for separate attention.

test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh FAILed once inside the complete-gate-set run (ambient 1-minute load average 6.71-9.09 from unrelated concurrent LaTeX/pytest processes on this machine, flagged by verify-deploy.sh's own [CONTENTION] marker). Re-run twice afterward (once alone, once inside the same 3-suite group) both passed cleanly. Treated as a load-induced flake, not a regression; trusting the two clean re-runs over the single contended one.

Task 650's postflight completion write was refused by the completion-deploy gate (exit 6): the deployed .claude/ tree was stale relative to the source store at completion time. Deferred to the next cycle's Inter-Cycle Redeploy Checkpoint to deploy and reconcile.
